findings.why: The new README example leaves out a signer. mangsang.py:2037-2038 `cmd_move` exits with "say who moves them (--by) or why the human delegated it (--delegated), or --dry-run" unless one of those is given, so the command fails exactly as written. The `--help` usage line also says `move [ID...] --by NAME | --delegated WHY [--dry-run]`. The README's own rule is to verify CLI examples against `--help`. The brief says inconsistencies are fixed in a separate task and this task adopts the edits unchanged, so this is noted rather than treated as a reason to reject. Everything else checked out: the navigation anchors resolve to existing headings, impact's argument-hint matches its parser (--show, --findings, --only), and running_agent() (mangsang.py:131-143) matches the new reconfirm identity order (CODEX_THREAD_ID, Claude model or Claude Code, AGENT_WORKER).
